## Conclusions
- **The pipeline works end to end** on Samsung Galaxy S22 (Family) with QNN (`qnn_dlc`, the sample's options):
  export → compile → profile → on-device inference → official score.
- MobileCLIP2-S0: 6.84 ms image + 3.22 ms text = **10.06 ms** (TFLite in the teammate's notebook: 9.70 ms). All 222
  image and 335 text layers run on the NPU. Peak memory is 123 / 154 MiB.
- Device frac R@10 on the sample: **89.30** (local FP32 88.85; teammate's TFLite run 89.40).
- Fidelity: device vs. local PyTorch embeddings have cosine ≥ 0.9998 (image) and ≥ 0.99999 (text) on every sample input.
  **So local RefCOCOg-LPCVC accuracy is a valid proxy for the deployed float model**; we re-check fidelity after
  quantization.
- One profile run only; experiment 004 repeats each profile 3 times.
- Note: qai_hub 0.58 warns that `submit_profile_job` is deprecated (it now returns an InferenceJob). It still works.
  Switch to `submit_inference_job(..., profile=True)` when we touch that code next.
